content.comment_body: For those experiencing a similar issue in macOS Monterey, where access to the Documents folder in your home directory is blocked, try this: In system preferences, under security & privacy, remove [product_name] from the Files and Folders section. Then, ensure [product_name] is granted Full Disk Access. This issue appears to occur after upgrading from [version_no] to [version_no].
Thanks, this solution worked perfectly for me and really helped.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a permissions issue with [product_name] on macOS Monterey, preventing access to the Documents folder after updating from [version_no] to [version_no]. Granting Full Disk Access to the application resolved the problem, suggesting a change in permissions handling triggered by the software update.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to maintain access to required file directories after updates, operating smoothly without the need for extra manual permissions adjustments.
